info.title: API.SH: Blocket
info.description: The Blocket API from API.SH: public Blocket data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Blocket's marketplace categories in three levels (category, sub-category, product category) with their ids (what the search takes as `category`) and live listing counts, plus the other search filters with their values and counts (location, condition, seller type, ad type, shipping, brand). vertical=cars gives the car makes and models instead.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/blocket-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Blocket marketplace ad: price, trade type, condition, full description, every attribute, category path, location (postcode, place, coordinates), photos, last edit, shipping options and, for business sellers, the shop profile. Pass `id`, `url`, or `latest=1` with search params. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/blocket-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `1`: open the first current result of a search made with this route's search params (q, location and filters) instead of an id. Ads expire, so this keeps a link working.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Blocket (blocket.se) marketplace ads (or used cars with `vertical=cars`) for a keyword with category, location, radius around a point, price, condition, seller type, trade type, shipping, published today and sort, plus any other filter the site lists in `filters` (pass as `filters=name:value`). Each result has price (SEK), location and coordinates, published time, photos, labels and, for business sellers, the shop name; car results add make, model, year, mileage, fuel, transmission and dealer. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/blocket-search

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude for a radius search (with lng).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Any other site filter as name:value, comma-separated (names and values from `filters`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

results.title: Ikea vimle soffa i fint skick

get.description:
A business seller (shop) on Blocket and every ad it has up: with an ad id the shop's name, phone, website, address, logo, profile page and company lookup link; then its ads with price, location, coordinates, date, photos and labels, and the total. Private sellers have no public list of ads. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/blocket-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One of the shop's ads (id or link): gives the shop profile too.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An ad link instead of id.

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: The shop's organisation id instead of an ad.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
